Dated : 18/12/2023.

2. By this application, the applicants seek to quash First Information Report vide Crime No.
1038/2023 registered with Police with Police Station Avdhutwadi, Dist. Yavatmal for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 420, 465, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3.
It is brought to our notice that in the same crime, this Court vide its order dated 13.10.2023 in Criminal Application No. 1421/2023 has granted interim protection.
4. Issue notice to the non-applicants returnable after four weeks.

Learned APP waives service of notice to the non-applicant No.1.
5.
In the meantime, investigation may go on, but charge-sheet shall not be filed without obtaining leave of this Court.
This application be tagged with Criminal Application No. 1421/2023.
